text: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
Make for yourself two trumpets of silver! A hammered work; you shall make them, and they will be for you to call the congregation, and to lift away the camps.
And you shall trump with them, and bring together all the congregation unto the door of the tent of the testimony.
But if [[2]with [3]one sound; [1]they should trump], then shall come forward to you all the rulers of the heads of Israel.

And you shall trump for a signal a second time, and shall lift away the camps ; camping according to the south. And you shall trump [[2]signal [1]a third], and shall lift away the camps ; camping by the west.
